items.title: Hepatocyte-derived exosomal miR-122 mediates liver-to-brain crosstalk and neuroinflammation in alcohol-exposed Alzheimer's disease mice.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Veronika Brezani; Marti Ortega-Ribera; Neda Rezagholizadeh; Radhika Joshi; Viliam Brezani; Mrigya Babuta; Bruna de Araujo Cardoso Dos Santos; Adam Zivny
items.abstract: Neuroinflammation and microglial activation are common features in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and excessive alcohol consumption. Alcohol induces liver damage and inflammation, and altered serum aminotransferases have been reported in patients with AD. Small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) and their cargo are emerging as mediators of intercellular communication in AD and alcohol-induced liver injury. However, the effects of alcohol use on AD progression remain to be elucidated. In this study, we evaluated the effects of repeated binge drinking on the liver and brain in the APP/PS1 mouse model of AD. Alcohol-exposed APP/PS1 mice showed elevated serum alanine aminotransferase levels, indicating liver injury absent in controls, along with increased pro-inflammatory cytokine expression in both liver and brain. Alcohol increased the biogenesis and release of sEVs in AD mice and in mouse hepatocytes. These sEVs were enriched in mature miR-122-5p that is predominant in hepatocytes. In vivo, miR-122-5p was detected in the brain of alcohol-exposed AD mice suggesting EV-mediated miR-122-5p transfer to the brain. Microglial uptake of hepatocyte-derived sEVs was confirmed in vitro. sEVs from alcohol-treated hepatocytes sensitized BV-2 microglia to LPS stimulation, significantly enhancing CCL2, CXCL2, CCL3, and TNF-α production. Transfection of microglia with a miR-122-5p mimic partially recapitulated the pro-inflammatory sensitization by sEVs from alcohol-exposed hepatocytes, which was reversed by miR-122-5p inhibitor delivery. ADAM10, a miR-122-5p target, was reduced in both wild-type and AD brains after alcohol exposure, with cell-specific effects. These results suggest that alcohol-induced hepatocyte-derived sEVs may modulate liver-to-brain signaling via miR-122-5p and contribute to neuroinflammation in AD.

items.abstract_cn: 神经炎症和小胶质细胞激活是阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 和过量饮酒的常见特征。据报道，酒精会引起肝损伤和炎症，并且 AD 患者血清转氨酶发生改变。小细胞外囊泡 (sEV) 及其负载物正在成为 AD 和酒精性肝损伤中细胞间通讯的介质。然而，饮酒对 AD 进展的影响仍有待阐明。在这项研究中，我们评估了反复酗酒对 APP/PS1 AD 小鼠模型肝脏和大脑的影响。暴露于酒精的 APP/PS1 小鼠血清丙氨酸氨基转移酶水平升高，表明对照组不存在肝损伤，并且肝脏和大脑中促炎细胞因子表达增加。酒精增加了 AD 小鼠和小鼠肝细胞中 sEV 的生物发生和释放。这些 sEV 富含成熟的 miR-122-5p，其在肝细胞中占主导地位。在体内，在酒精暴露的 AD 小鼠的大脑中检测到 miR-122-5p，表明 EV 介导的 miR-122-5p 转移到大脑。体外证实了小胶质细胞对肝细胞来源的 sEV 的摄取。来自酒精处理的肝细胞的 sEV 使 BV-2 小胶质细胞对 LPS 刺激敏感，显着增强 CCL2、CXCL2、CCL3 和 TNF-α 的产生。用 miR-122-5p 模拟物转染小胶质细胞，部分重现了来自酒精暴露肝细胞的 sEV 的促炎致敏作用，而 miR-122-5p 抑制剂递送可逆转这种作用。 ADAM10 是 miR-122-5p 的靶标，在酒精暴露后，野生型和 AD 大脑中的 ADAM10 均减少，并具有细胞特异性效应。这些结果表明，酒精诱导的肝细胞来源的 sEV 可能通过 miR-122-5p 调节肝到脑的信号传导，并导致 AD 中的神经炎症。

items.title: Lighting up necrotic neurons from traumatic brain injury with magnetic quantum dots to decode the cellular origin of MRI.
items.authors: Mingxia Jiao; Xin Zhao; Jingyun Wang; Wanru Tian; Yao Li; Xuan Cheng; Kun Zhang; Xiliang Luo
items.abstract: The diagnosis of traumatic brain injury (TBI) remains heavily constrained by the limitations of conventional imaging techniques in visualizing the pathological events that determine the disease progression and outcome. To address this clinical challenge, we report a manganese-doped near-infrared quantum dot (QD) to intrinsically integrate the highly sensitive optical imaging with clinical compatible magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Taking the advantages of optical imaging powered by whole-brain clearing and cellular resolution three-dimensional (3D) panoptic imaging, in combination with the systematic in vitro cell studies on different types of cells involved in TBI, we disclosed the interpretable pathology reflected by TBI imaging through the highly sensitive fluorescence of magnetic QDs, i.e., after systemic administration, the nanoprobes were extravasated through the compromised blood-brain barrier and then selectively phagocytosed by activated microglia, which subsequently migrated into the regions rich in dead neurons and neuronal debris. This microglia-mediated tropism decodes the signal origin of MRI enhanced by the nanometer-sized contrast agent, thereby transforming the MRI from an anatomical tool into a pathological reporter. A biocompatible Fe3O4 nanoparticle of similar size was also compared with the magnetic QD mentioned above for validating the translational merits of nanoparticles in MRI diagnosis of TBI.
items.title_en: Lighting up necrotic neurons from traumatic brain injury with magnetic quantum dots to decode the cellular origin of MRI.
items.title_cn: 用磁性量子点点亮脑外伤造成的坏死神经元，以解码 MRI 的细胞起源。
items.abstract_cn: 传统成像技术在可视化决定疾病进展和结果的病理事件方面的局限性仍然严重限制了创伤性脑损伤（TBI）的诊断。为了解决这一临床挑战，我们报告了一种掺锰近红外量子点（QD），可将高灵敏度光学成像与临床兼容的磁共振成像（MRI）本质上结合起来。利用全脑透明光学成像和细胞分辨率三维（3D）全景成像的优势，结合对参与TBI的不同类型细胞的系统体外细胞研究，我们通过磁性量子点的高灵敏荧光揭示了TBI成像所反映的可解释的病理学，即全身给药后，纳米探针通过受损的血脑屏障外渗，然后被激活的小胶质细胞选择性吞噬，随后迁移到TBI中。富含死亡神经元和神经元碎片的区域。这种小胶质细胞介导的趋向性解码了纳米级造影剂增强的 MRI 信号源，从而将 MRI 从解剖工具转变为病理报告器。还将类似尺寸的生物相容性 Fe3O4 纳米颗粒与上述磁性量子点进行了比较，以验证纳米颗粒在 TBI MRI 诊断中的转化优点。

items.title: Ciprofol more broadly suppresses selected inflammatory markers than propofol in LPS-induced sepsis-associated encephalopathy.
items.authors: Qiuyan Wan; Suihan Xu; Hongxia He; Jun Wang; Yinhao Guo; Kun Peng; Jun Li
items.abstract: To investigate and compare the anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects of ciprofol and propofol in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced sepsis-associated encephalopathy(SAE). C57BL/6 N mice with LPS-induced SAE were treated with propofol(LP) or ciprofol(LC). Cognitive function was assessed by the Morris water maze (MWM) and novel object recognition (NOR) tests. Neuroinflammation and glial activation in the hippocampus were evaluated by histology, immunohistochemistry (IHC), immunofluorescence (IF), and RT-qPCR. Systemic and cellular inflammatory responses were measured by ELISA. In vitro, BV2 microglial cells were treated with LPS, LP, or LC, and their effects on neuronal viability were assessed in a co-culture system. Underlying mechanisms were explored by Western Blot and RT-qPCR. In vivo, both ciprofol and propofol produced comparable improvements in cognitive outcomes, and representative H&E- and Nissl-stained sections showed similar histological patterns. At the tested doses, ciprofol more broadly suppressed selected inflammatory markers. Systemically, ciprofol significantly reduced all three tested cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6), whereas propofol significantly reduced TNF-α only. In the hippocampus, ciprofol produced greater reductions in Il-1β transcription and Iba-1-positive cells in the dentate gyrus. In vitro, ciprofol also produced greater reductions in selected proinflammatory mediators in BV2 cells. Mechanistically, ciprofol was associated with greater suppression of Nlrp3 mRNA, whereas the corresponding between-drug protein-level difference was not significant. In murine LPS-induced SAE, ciprofol and propofol produced comparable improvements in cognitive outcomes and similar histological observations, whereas ciprofol more broadly suppressed selected systemic and hippocampal inflammatory markers and was associated with greater Nlrp3 transcriptional suppression in BV2 cells at the tested doses or concentrations. These preclinical findings require confirmation in clinically relevant sepsis models and human studies before they can inform anesthetic selection in patients with sepsis.
items.title_en: Ciprofol more broadly suppresses selected inflammatory markers than propofol in LPS-induced sepsis-associated encephalopathy.
items.title_cn: 在 LPS 诱导的脓毒症相关脑病中，环丙酚比丙泊酚更广泛地抑制选定的炎症标志物。
items.abstract_cn: 探讨并比较环丙酚和丙泊酚在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的脓毒症相关脑病（SAE）中的抗炎和神经保护作用。用丙泊酚 (LP) 或环丙酚 (LC) 治疗患有 LPS 诱导的 SAE 的 C57BL/6 N 小鼠。通过莫里斯水迷宫（MWM）和新物体识别（NOR）测试评估认知功能。通过组织学、免疫组织化学 (IHC)、免疫荧光 (IF) 和 RT-qPCR 评估海马神经炎症和胶质细胞活化。通过 ELISA 测量全身和细胞炎症反应。在体外，用 LPS、LP 或 LC 处理 BV2 小胶质细胞，并在共培养系统中评估它们对神经元活力的影响。通过蛋白质印迹和 RT-qPCR 探索了潜在机制。在体内，环丙酚和丙泊酚都对认知结果产生了相当的改善，并且代表性的 H&E 和尼氏染色切片显示出相似的组织学模式。在测试剂量下，环丙酚更广泛地抑制选定的炎症标志物。全身性地，环丙酚显着降低所有三种测试的细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6），而异丙酚仅显着降低TNF-α。在海马体中，环丙酚使齿状回中的 Il-1β 转录和 Iba-1 阳性细胞产生更大的减少。在体外，环丙酚还可以更大程度地减少 BV2 细胞中选定的促炎介质。从机制上讲，环丙酚与 Nlrp3 mRNA 的更大抑制相关，而相应的药物间蛋白质水平差异并不显着。在小鼠 LPS 诱导的 SAE 中，环丙酚和丙泊酚在认知结果和相似的组织学观察方面产生了相当的改善，而环丙酚更广泛地抑制了选定的全身和海马炎症标志物，并且在测试剂量或浓度下与 BV2 细胞中更大的 Nlrp3 转录抑制相关。这些临床前研究结果需要在临床相关脓毒症模型和人体研究中得到确认，然后才能为脓毒症患者的麻醉选择提供信息。

items.title: Behavioral, biochemical, histological, and electrophysiological changes following intracerebral injection of bone marrow stem cell-derived exosomes in male rat models of Alzheimer's disease.
items.authors: Azam Karimi; Elham Hoveizi; Lotfollah Khajehpour; Zohreh Ghotbeddin
items.abstract: Recently, researchers have been exploring how exosomes can help treat neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer's disease (AD), has attracted considerable attention. This study aimed to investigate behavioral, biochemical, histological, and electrophysiological changes following the administration of bone marrow stem cell-derived exosomes (Exo-BMSCs) in AD model rats. Animals were divided into control, Lesion (Lesion, Lesion + saline), and treatment (Lesion + BMSCs, Lesion + Exo-BMSCs) groups. BMSCs were extracted from the bone marrow of newborn rats. Exosomes were extracted from the BMSCs culture medium using a chemical kit. Saline, BMSCs, and Exo-BMSCs were injected bilaterally into the nucleus of Meynert (NBM) one week after electrical lesion. 28 days after injection, behavioral, electrophysiological, and histological changes, as well as ACh and BDNF expression levels in the hippocampus, were evaluated. Electrical lesion of the NBM caused a significant decrease in passive avoidance memory retrieval, a significant decrease in ACh and BDNF levels, changes in EEG wave frequencies in the hippocampus, and histological changes in the NBM, similar to those observed in AD. On the other hand, injection of BMSCs and Exo-BMSCs into the NBM significantly improved passive avoidance memory, an increase in BDNF levels, an increase in power of gamma waves, and improved histological changes compared to the Lesion groups. The increase in power of gamma waves was significant only in the Exo-BMSC-treated group. Injection of BMSCs and Exo-BMSCs into the NBM can significantly improve disease symptoms. This improvement was more pronounced in the Exo-BMSCs-treated group. The concurrent increase in BDNF suggests that this neurotrophin contributes to the observed effects.

items.title: Human Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Exosomes Preserve Cartilage Homeostasis and Restore Joint Function in Experimental Osteoarthritis.
items.journal: The Kaohsiung journal of medical sciences
items.authors: Sung-Yen Lin; Yi-Shan Lin; Shu-Chun Chuang; Yi-Wen Kuo; Cheng-Jung Ho; Kai-Hsuan Wang; Wei-Cheng Tsai; Zhi-Xiang Li
items.abstract: Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) have shown therapeutic potential for osteoarthritis (OA), but their clinical application is limited by the need for extensive ex vivo expansion. Human umbilical cord MSC-derived exosomes (hUCMSC-Exos) have emerged as a promising cell-free alternative because of their cartilage-protective and immunomodulatory properties. hUCMSC-Exos were characterized by nanoparticle tracking analysis and evaluated in an interleukin-1β (IL-1β)-stimulated human chondrocyte model and an anterior cruciate ligament transection (ACLT)-induced rat OA model. In vitro, hUCMSC-Exos suppressed inflammatory and catabolic responses while enhancing extracellular matrix synthesis, as evidenced by reduced IL-1β, MMP13, and Type X collagen expression and increased TIMP1, aggrecan, and Type II collagen expression. In vivo, repeated intra-articular administration of hUCMSC-Exos attenuated cartilage degeneration, resulting in improved gross joint morphology, reduced histopathological damage, increased glycosaminoglycan deposition and Type II collagen expression, and decreased MMP13 expression. These structural improvements were accompanied by enhanced functional recovery, as demonstrated by improved hind limb weight-bearing and treadmill running endurance. These findings suggest that hUCMSC-Exos alleviate cartilage degeneration and improve joint function, supporting their potential as a promising cell-free therapeutic approach for OA.

items.title_cn: 人脐带间充质干细胞衍生的外泌体在实验性骨关节炎中保持软骨稳态并恢复关节功能。
items.abstract_cn: 间充质干细胞（MSC）已显示出治疗骨关节炎（OA）的潜力，但其临床应用因需要广泛的离体扩增而受到限制。人脐带 MSC 衍生的外泌体 (hUCMSC-Exos) 由于其软骨保护和免疫调节特性而成为一种有前途的无细胞替代品。 hUCMSC-Exos 通过纳米颗粒跟踪分析进行表征，并在白介素 1β (IL-1β) 刺激的人软骨细胞模型和前交叉韧带横断 (ACLT) 诱导的大鼠 OA 模型中进行评估。在体外，hUCMSC-Exos 抑制炎症和分解代谢反应，同时增强细胞外基质合成，这一点可以通过减少 IL-1β、MMP13 和 X 型胶原表达以及增加 TIMP1、聚集蛋白聚糖和 II 型胶原表达来证明。在体内，反复关节内施用hUCMSC-Exos可减轻软骨退化，从而改善大体关节形态，减少组织病理学损伤，增加糖胺聚糖沉积和II型胶原表达，并减少MMP13表达。这些结构的改进伴随着功能恢复的增强，后肢负重和跑步耐力的改善证明了这一点。这些发现表明 hUCMSC-Exos 可以减轻软骨退化并改善关节功能，支持其作为一种有前景的 OA 无细胞治疗方法的潜力。

items.title: A narrative review of rare variants in Alzheimer's disease: diverse populations inform diverse mechanisms.
items.journal: Neurological sciences : official journal of the Italian Neurological Society and of the Italian Society of Clinical Neurophysiology
items.authors: Miguel Tábuas-Pereira; Isabel Santana; Celia Kun-Rodrigues; Kimberly Paquette; José Brás; Rita Guerreiro
items.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Alzheimer's disease (AD) heritability is estimated to be 58-79%. However, much is yet to be explained. Rare variation is one potential source of missing heritability in complex traits. We reviewed the studies that first identified rare variants associated with AD, comparing the characteristics of their samples (comparing studies focusing on "restricted" populations vs. studies from multiple populations) and reviewing what biological processes and molecular mechanisms they may support. OBSERVATIONS: We conducted a review of rare variant association studies in AD, identifying 64 variants across 39 genes (ABCA7, AC099552.4, ACER3, ADAM17, AKAP9, APP, APOE, API5, ASRGL1/TUT1, ATP8B4, BIN1, C15ORF41/CDIN1, CASP7, CASP8, CD2AP, COBL, COL4A1, CR1, CST3, EPHA1, FUS, IGF1R/ARRDC4, LINC00298, MYRF, NCK2, NOTCH3, PIK3C2G, PLD3, PLCG2, PLXNC1, PTK2B, RAB3B, SORL1, SPOCK3/ANXA10, TCIRG1, TREM2, UNC5C, WASHC5). There is an overrepresentation of genes related with amyloid-beta, phagocytosis, apoptotic cells engulfment, membrane invagination and cellular component organization. Thirty (45.5%) studies were performed in "restricted" discovery populations. These had lower number of cases and lower MAF on cases than the studies from multiple populations. CONCLUSIONS: Studies in populations from a restricted ancestry or region of collection have been fruitful in revealing rare variants associated with disease. Diverse backgrounds have revealed different variants - some genes have only been implicated in AD by the identification of rare variants in these populations. Enrichment analyses of associated genes revealed overrepresentation in biological processes related to amyloid-beta metabolism, phagocytosis and engulfment of apoptotic cells, regulation of cell migration and cell component organization, locomotion, and immune related responses. These results highlight the importance of diverse but focused genetic studies.

items.title: Feasibility and Safety of Prone Positioning for Atelectasis in Neurocritical Patients: A Historically Controlled Study.
items.journal: The Journal of neuroscience nursing : journal of the American Association of Neuroscience Nurses
items.authors: Wenya Cao; Hong Chang; Tong Ji; Linlin Fan; Fei Tian; Zhimin Li; Yan Zhang
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Prone positioning is effective for atelectasis but underutilized in neurocritical care due to concerns about neurological safety. This study examined the clinical outcomes and tolerability of prone positioning in a neurocritical care population predominantly comprising patients with encephalitis and status epilepticus. METHODS: In this historically controlled study, neurocritical care patients with atelectasis received either 135-degree semiprone positioning plus standard physiotherapy (intervention) or standard physiotherapy alone (historical control). The cohort primarily included patients with encephalitis or status epilepticus (66%); those with intracerebral hemorrhage or traumatic brain injury were not represented. Outcomes included oxygenation (PaO2/FiO2 ratio), CT-based atelectasis score, and clinical endpoints. RESULTS: Forty-seven patients in the prone group and 50 controls were analyzed. The prone group demonstrated significantly improved PaO2/FiO2 ratios at days 3, 5, and 7 (all P<.05) and greater atelectasis resolution (P=.002). Mechanical ventilation duration was shorter in the prone group (14.11 vs. 16.82 d, P=.045). ICU stay, mortality, and neurological outcomes were comparable between groups. No serious adverse events attributable to prone positioning occurred. CONCLUSION: Prone positioning was feasible and well-tolerated in this selected neurocritical care cohort, with improved respiratory outcomes and no detectable safety signals. These findings support consideration of prone positioning in similar patient populations, though further research is needed in patients with elevated intracranial pressure risk. In clinical practice, prone positioning can be safely implemented by a trained nursing team using clinical observation in selected neurocritical care patients with stable intracranial pressure.

items.abstract_cn: 背景：俯卧位对于肺不张有效，但由于担心神经安全性，在神经重症监护中未得到充分利用。这项研究检查了主要由脑炎和癫痫持续状态患者组成的神经重症监护人群中俯卧位的临床结果和耐受性。方法：在这项历史对照研究中，患有肺不张的神经重症监护患者接受 135 度半俯卧位加标准物理治疗（干预）或单独标准物理治疗（历史对照）。该队列主要包括脑炎或癫痫持续状态患者（66%）；脑出血或脑外伤患者没有代表。结果包括氧合（PaO2/FiO2 比率）、基于 CT 的肺不张评分和临床终点。结果：对 47 名俯卧组患者和 50 名对照组患者进行了分析。俯卧组在第 3、5 和 7 天的 PaO2/FiO2 比率显着改善（所有 P<.05），并且肺不张的缓解率更高（P=.002）。俯卧组的机械通气持续时间较短（14.11 与 16.82 d，P=.045）。各组之间的 ICU 住院时间、死亡率和神经系统结果具有可比性。没有发生因俯卧位引起的严重不良事件。结论：在这个选定的神经重症监护队列中，俯卧位是可行的且耐受性良好，可以改善呼吸结果，并且没有可检测到的安全信号。这些发现支持在类似患者群体中考虑俯卧位，但对于颅内压风险升高的患者还需要进一步研究。在临床实践中，训练有素的护理团队可以通过对选定的颅内压稳定的神经重症监护患者的临床观察，安全地实施俯卧位。

items.title: Secondary lymphedema associated with chronic graft-vs-host disease following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation: a case-based review.
items.abstract: Secondary lymphedema is a recognized complication of hematologic disease and its treatment, most often arising from direct lymphatic infiltration by malignancy or from post-treatment fibrosis; rarer associations include tyrosine kinase inhibitor-related fluid retention and genetic syndromes such as Emberger syndrome, in which primary lymphedema co-occurs with a predisposition to leukemia. We report a 26-year-old man with acute myeloid leukemia treated with allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) who developed bilateral lower extremity secondary lymphedema while receiving sorafenib, imatinib, and mycophenolate mofetil for chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) with a sicca-predominant phenotype. Lymphoscintigraphy confirmed bilaterally impaired lymphatic flow, and the lymphedema was classified as International Society of Lymphology stage II. Thirty sessions of complete decongestive therapy produced marked improvement, sustained with compression garments despite a later severe cGVHD flare. This case, apparently the first reported instance of lymphedema arising specifically in the context of cGVHD, is discussed alongside the differential contribution of imatinib-associated fluid retention and the mechanistic plausibility of cGVHD-related fibrosis, to raise awareness of secondary lymphedema as an underrecognized complication in this population and to support early referral for physical medicine and rehabilitation.

items.abstract_cn: 继发性淋巴水肿是血液系统疾病及其治疗的公认并发症，最常由恶性肿瘤直接淋巴浸润或治疗后纤维化引起；较罕见的关联包括酪氨酸激酶抑制剂相关的体液潴留和遗传综合征，例如 Emberger 综合征，其中原发性淋巴水肿与白血病倾向同时发生。我们报道了一名 26 岁男性急性髓性白血病患者，接受同种异体造血干细胞移植 (allo-HSCT) 治疗，在接受索拉非尼、伊马替尼和吗替麦考酚酯治疗以干燥为主的慢性移植物抗宿主病 (cGVHD) 期间，出现双侧下肢继发性淋巴水肿。淋巴闪烁扫描证实双侧淋巴流动受损，淋巴水肿被国际淋巴学会分类为 II 期。三十次完整的减充血治疗取得了显着的改善，尽管后来出现了严重的 cGVHD 发作，但仍穿着压力衣持续改善。该病例显然是第一个报道的专门在 cGVHD 背景下发生的淋巴水肿病例，与伊马替尼相关液体潴留的不同贡献和 cGVHD 相关纤维化的机制合理性一起讨论，以提高继发性淋巴水肿作为该人群中未被充分认识的并发症的认识，并支持早期转诊物理医学和康复。

items.title: A ROS-Responsive Injectable Hydrogel Platform Reprograms the Diabetic Wound Microenvironment to Enable Exosome Therapy.
items.authors: Zhiwei Shao; Qiao Wang; Rijian Song; Jingyu Zhang; Pengxu Chen; Roberto Garmondyu Reeves; Changbo Tao; Caiqi Shen
items.abstract: Diabetic wounds persist because excessive reactive oxygen species (ROS) sustain chronic inflammation and disrupt the regenerative microenvironment, impairing the stability and function of bioactive therapeutic components, including stem cells and extracellular vesicles (EVs). Here, an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) hydrogel integrates microenvironment modulation with regenerative cue delivery by co-encapsulating ROS-responsive cerium oxide nanozymes (CeO2 NPs) and mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes (EXOs). In this system, CeO2 NPs act as antioxidant regulators that respond to oxidative stress, while EXOs provide regenerative signals for tissue repair. CeO2 NPs are packaged within a thioketal-linked PLGA-PEG shell, enabling ROS-triggered degradation and on-demand activation, whereas the in situ crosslinked HA network serves as a localized matrix that protects components and synchronizes their sustained co-release. Under high-glucose conditions, the composite hydrogel reduces intracellular ROS, restores mitochondrial membrane potential, and enhances proliferation, migration, and angiogenic activity of endothelial cells and fibroblasts. In a diabetic mouse wound model, the hydrogel accelerates wound closure, accompanied by attenuated oxidative stress and inflammation, enhanced neovascularization and re-epithelialization, organized collagen remodeling, and a shift of macrophages toward a pro-regenerative M2 phenotype. This pathology-responsive antioxidant-regenerative coupling strategy establishes a rational, modular platform for overcoming microenvironmental constraints in exosome-based regenerative therapies.
items.title_en: A ROS-Responsive Injectable Hydrogel Platform Reprograms the Diabetic Wound Microenvironment to Enable Exosome Therapy.
items.title_cn: ROS 响应性可注射水凝胶平台重新编程糖尿病伤口微环境以实现外泌体治疗。
items.abstract_cn: 糖尿病伤口持续存在是因为过量的活性氧（ROS）维持慢性炎症并破坏再生微环境，损害生物活性治疗成分（包括干细胞和细胞外囊泡（EV））的稳定性和功能。在这里，可注射的透明质酸（HA）水凝胶通过共同封装ROS响应性氧化铈纳米酶（CeO2 NP）和间充质干细胞衍生的外泌体（EXO），将微环境调节与再生线索传递结合起来。在该系统中，CeO2 NPs充当抗氧化调节剂，响应氧化应激，而EXOs则提供用于组织修复的再生信号。 CeO2 NPs 包装在硫缩酮连接的 PLGA-PEG 壳内，可实现 ROS 触发的降解和按需激活，而原位交联的 HA 网络则充当局部基质，保护组分并同步其持续共释放。在高葡萄糖条件下，复合水凝胶减少细胞内ROS，恢复线粒体膜电位，增强内皮细胞和成纤维细胞的增殖、迁移和血管生成活性。在糖尿病小鼠伤口模型中，水凝胶可加速伤口闭合，同时减轻氧化应激和炎症、增强新血管形成和上皮再形成、有组织的胶原蛋白重塑以及巨噬细胞向促再生 M2 表型的转变。这种病理响应性抗氧化-再生耦合策略建立了一个合理的模块化平台，用于克服基于外泌体的再生疗法中的微环境限制。

items.title: ApoE-dependent lipid handling by median eminence microglia supports myelin remodeling and metabolic function.
items.authors: Emily R McGrath; Andrew Folick; Luke J Morrissette; Stephen M Brown Mayfield; Hyehyun Kim; Li-Fang Weng; Vivian Pham; Sriya N Pillutla
items.abstract: Microglia regulate hypothalamic control of systemic metabolism, but the mechanisms underlying their contribution remain unclear. Here, we identify apolipoprotein E (ApoE)-associated microglial transcriptional states enriched in the median eminence (ME), a brain region involved in sensing peripheral cues and metabolic regulation. These transcriptional states are characterized by programs related to lipid handling, interferon-associated responses, and cellular stress. Consumption of a Western diet (WD) increased microglial lipid accumulation and altered myelin remodeling within the ME, while expression of the human APOE4 isoform exacerbated these changes. Deletion of Apoe altered microglial responses to nutritional stress, supporting a role for ApoE in microglial lipid handling. Finally, activation of liver X receptor using synthetic high-density lipoprotein (sHDL) nanoparticles enhanced microglial lipid-handling programs, improved hypothalamic leptin responsiveness, reduced food intake, and limited weight gain in WD-fed mice. Together, these findings identify ApoE-dependent lipid handling as a key component of adaptive microglial responses to metabolic stress.
items.title_en: ApoE-dependent lipid handling by median eminence microglia supports myelin remodeling and metabolic function.
items.title_cn: 正中隆起小胶质细胞依赖 ApoE 的脂质处理支持髓磷脂重塑和代谢功能。
items.abstract_cn: 小胶质细胞调节下丘脑对全身代谢的控制，但其作用的机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们确定了载脂蛋白 E (ApoE) 相关的小胶质细胞转录状态富含中位隆起 (ME)，这是一个参与感知外周信号和代谢调节的大脑区域。这些转录状态的特征是与脂质处理、干扰素相关反应和细胞应激相关的程序。西方饮食 (WD) 的摄入增加了小胶质细胞脂质积累并改变了 ME 内的髓磷脂重塑，而人 APOE4 同工型的表达加剧了这些变化。 ApoE 的缺失改变了小胶质细胞对营养应激的反应，支持了 ApoE 在小胶质细胞脂质处理中的作用。最后，使用合成高密度脂蛋白 (sHDL) 纳米颗粒激活肝脏 X 受体可增强小胶质细胞脂质处理程序，改善下丘脑瘦素反应性，减少食物摄入，并限制 WD 喂养小鼠的体重增加。总之，这些发现确定 ApoE 依赖性脂质处理是小胶质细胞对代谢应激的适应性反应的关键组成部分。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Salovum® reduces mortality in isolated severe traumatic brain injury: a randomized phase II trial.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: David Cederberg; Bradley M Harrington; Iain Walker; Ruan Grobler; Nitesh Naranbhai; Ryan K Jacobs; Edward Visse; Niklas Marklund
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Isolated severe traumatic brain injury (TBI) is associated with high mortality and long-term morbidity, especially in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Despite promising results using pharmacological and non-pharmacological therapies in the experimental setting, no clinical trials have demonstrated robust efficacy. We aimed to investigate the effect of antisecretory factor (Salovum®) on 30-day mortality in adult patients with severe TBI. This was a prospective, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial, conducted from September 2017 to February 2022 in a tertiary trauma centre (university hospital) in Cape Town, South Africa (www.clinicaltrials.gov: NCT03339505). The participants were adults with isolated severe TBI (Glasgow Coma Score 6-8), receiving intracranial pressure (ICP) monitoring and neurointensive care. Participants were administered either Salovum® (freeze-dried egg yolk powder enriched with the active compound antisecretory factor) or placebo (freeze dried egg yolk powder) via the nasogastric tubing, dosed according to weight (10-17 g/4 h) and initiated at 32.9 h ± 10.7 h (mean ± standard deviation) post-injury. top_journal_neuroscience.title: Plasma tau-species-positive neuron-derived extracellular vesicles in progressive supranuclear palsy.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Yuanchu Zheng; Huihui Cai; Wenyi Kou; Genliang Liu; Yanlin Wang; Jing Bai; Yingshan Piao; Xuedong Liu
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: The diagnosis of progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) remains challenging, particularly in differentiating it from Parkinson's disease (PD) at early stages. Circulating neuron-derived extracellular vesicles (NDEVs), providing a peripheral window into CNS pathology, might serve as promising biomarkers. A total of 188 participants were recruited from three centres. A discovery cohort [40 PSP patients, 36 PD patients and 31 healthy controls (HCs)] and a multicentre validation cohort (30 PSP patients, 27 PD patients and 24 HCs) were established. NDEVs containing total tau, 4R tau or phosphorylated tau (ptau181, ptau217, ptau231 and ptau396) in plasma samples were analysed using nano-scale flow cytometry. Multivariable logistic regression models were developed in the discovery cohort and strictly validated in the independent cohort using fixed model parameters. In the discovery cohort, the concentrations of tau-, 4R tau-, ptau181- and ptau217-containing NDEVs in PSP patients were significantly higher than those in HCs and PD patients, whereas ptau396-containing NDEVs showed elevation exclusively in PSP compared with HCs (PSP versus HCs: P < 0.001 for tau, P < 0.001 for 4R tau, P < 0.001 for ptau181, P = 0.008 for ptau217, and P = 0.009 for ptau396; PSP versus PD: P < 0.001 for tau, P < 0.001for4R tau, P = 0.029 for ptau181, and P = 0.003 for ptau217). An integrated model incorporating these biomarkers achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.965 (90.0% sensitivity, 96.8% specificity) for distinguishing PSP from HCs and an AUC of 0.963 (87.5% sensitivity, 94.4% specificity) for distinguishing PSP from PD. In the validation cohort, the concentrations of tau-, 4R tau-, ptau181-, ptau217- and ptau396-containing NDEVs in plasma were significantly higher in PSP patients compared with HCs (PSP versus HCs: P < 0.001 for tau, 4R tau and ptau217, P = 0.03 for ptau181, and P = 0.017 for ptau396). Likewise, the concentrations of tau-, 4R tau-, ptau181- and ptau217- were higher in PSP patients than in PD patients (PSP versus PD: P < 0.001 for tau, 4R tau and ptau217, and P = 0.025 for ptau181). The integrated model yielded an AUC of 0.971 for distinguishing PSP from HCs and 0.990 for distinguishing PSP from PD. Notably, in early-stage patients, the integrated model achieved an AUC of 0.987 in differentiating early-stage PSP from PD. These findings indicate that plasma tau-species-containing NDEVs are promising biomarkers for PSP, offering high sensitivity and specificity for distinguishing PSP from both HCs and PD, particularly in early disease stages. Further large-scale, longitudinal studies are warranted to validate these findings fully and explore their role in PSP pathophysiology and progression.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: A spatiotemporal cancer cell trajectory underlies glioblastoma heterogeneity.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Grant de Jong; Fani Memi; Tannia Gracia; Olga Lazareva; Oliver Gould; Georgios Solomou; Alexander Aivazidis; Manas Dave
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Cancer cells show highly heterogeneous and plastic states in glioblastoma, an incurable brain tumour1-5. However, how these malignant states arise and whether they follow defined cellular trajectories across tumours is poorly understood. Here we generated a deep single-cell and spatial multi-omic atlas of human glioblastoma that pairs transcriptomic, epigenomic and genomic profiling of 12 tumours across many regions. We identify that glioblastoma heterogeneity is driven by spatially patterned transitions of cancer cells from developmental-like states towards those defined by a glial injury response and hypoxia. This cellular trajectory regionalizes tumours into distinct tissue microenvironments and manifests in a molecularly conserved manner across tumours as well as genetically distinct tumour subclones. Consistently, using a new deep-learning framework to map cancer cell states jointly with clones in situ, we show that tumour subclones are finely spatially intermixed through glioblastoma tissue microenvironments. We validate this cellular trajectory by using somatic mutation-based hierarchies in vivo and an experimental patient-derived organoid model ex vivo. Finally, we show that this cancer cell trajectory is intimately linked to myeloid heterogeneity and unfolds across regionalized myeloid signalling environments. Our findings define a stereotyped trajectory of cancer cells in glioblastoma and unify glioblastoma tumour heterogeneity into a tractable cellular and tissue framework.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 胶质母细胞瘤（一种无法治愈的脑肿瘤）中的癌细胞表现出高度异质性和可塑性状态1-5。然而，人们对这些恶性状态如何产生以及它们是否遵循肿瘤中确定的细胞轨迹知之甚少。在这里，我们生成了人类胶质母细胞瘤的深度单细胞和空间多组学图谱，该图谱将多个区域的 12 个肿瘤的转录组、表观基因组和基因组分析配对。我们发现胶质母细胞瘤异质性是由癌细胞从发育样状态向神经胶质损伤反应和缺氧定义的空间模式转变所驱动的。这种细胞轨迹将肿瘤划分为不同的组织微环境，并以分子保守的方式在肿瘤以及遗传上不同的肿瘤亚克隆中表现出来。一致地，使用新的深度学习框架与原位克隆联合绘制癌细胞状态，我们表明肿瘤亚克隆通过胶质母细胞瘤组织微环境在空间上精细地混合。我们通过体内基于体细胞突变的层次结构和离体实验性患者衍生的类器官模型来验证这种细胞轨迹。最后，我们表明这种癌细胞轨迹与骨髓异质性密切相关，并在区域化的骨髓信号传导环境中展开。我们的研究结果定义了胶质母细胞瘤中癌细胞的定型轨迹，并将胶质母细胞瘤肿瘤异质性统一到易于处理的细胞和组织框架中。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: P2RX7 drives inflammatory microglia and pathogenic extracellular vesicle secretion in tauopathy.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Victor Bodart-Santos; Arun Reddy Ravula; Yang You; Mohammad Abdullah; Zhi Ruan; Justice G Ellison; Stephanie Radhakishun; Nibedita Basu Ray
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: P2X purinoreceptor 7 (P2RX7), an ATP-gated ion channel, contributes to Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression, but its molecular mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we show that genetic disruption of P2rx7 mitigates brain atrophy, tau accumulation, and cognitive impairment in PS19 mice. Microglia-specific, but not astrocyte-specific, deletion of P2rx7 suppresses tau propagation. Single-cell RNA sequencing identifies a previously unrecognized first-responding microglial state (FRM) with prominent P2rx7 expression. P2RX7 promotes the transition from FRM to an inflammatory microglial state enriched in extracellular vesicle (EV) biogenesis. P2RX7 increases EV loading of tau and of mitochondrial proteins and DNA, which activate cytosolic DNA sensing and interferon signaling in recipient microglia. Tau-containing microglial EVs disrupt neuronal endolysosomal integrity and facilitate endosomal tau escape and phosphorylation. Thus, P2RX7 regulates the FRM branch point, driving inflammatory microglial transition and EV-mediated spread of tau and toxic mitochondrial molecules and highlighting the P2RX7-EV axis as a therapeutic target in AD.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Clinical and biochemical characterization of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in a CHCHD10 R15L family.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Justin Y Kwan; Christian I Lantz; Vlad A Korobeynikov; Allison Snyder; Xiaoping Huang; Taryn Haselhuhn; Katherine N Dore; Angelo Madruga
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Familial forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are potential candidates for gene-directed therapies, but many recently identified genes remain poorly characterized. Here, we provide a comprehensive clinical, neuropathological and biochemical description of familial ALS (fALS) caused by the heterozygous p.R15L missense mutation in the gene CHCHD10. Using a cross-sectional study design, we evaluated five affected and nine unaffected individuals from a large seven-generation pedigree with at least 68 affected members. The pedigree suggests a high (68%-81%) but incomplete disease penetrance. Through cloning of the disease allele from distant members of the family, we establish the disease haplotype in the family. Notably, the haplotype was distinct from that of a previously reported p.R15L mutation carrier with ALS, demonstrating that the variant is in a mutational hotspot. The clinical presentation was notable for being highly stereotyped; all affected individuals presented with the rare ALS variant flail arm syndrome (FAS; also known as brachial amyotrophic diplegia or Vulpian-Bernhardt syndrome), suggesting greater involvement of the cervical spinal cord. Consistently, neuropathology from one family member demonstrated substantially increased CHCHD10 protein aggregation and neuronal loss (though absent TDP-43 pathology) in the cervical versus lumbar spinal cord. This FAS phenotype could be captured by a simple timed finger-tapping task, suggesting potential utility for this task as a clinical biomarker. Additionally, through analysis of fibroblast lines from 12 mutation carriers, isogenic induced pluripotent stem cells and a knock-in mouse model, we determined that CHCHD10 with the R15L variant is stably expressed and retains substantial function both in cultured cells and in vivo, in contrast to prior reports. Conversely, we find loss-of-function (LoF) variants are more common in the population but are not associated with a highly penetrant form of ALS in the UK Biobank (31 in controls; 0 in cases). Together, this argues against LoF and in favour of toxic gain-of-function as the mechanism of disease pathogenesis, similar to the myopathy-causing variants in CHCHD10 (p.G58R and p.S59L). Finally, through proteomic analysis of CSF of variant carriers, we identify that CHCHD10 protein levels are elevated approximately 4-fold in mutation carriers, and that affected and unaffected individuals are differentiated by elevation of two neurofilaments: neurofilament light chain (NfL) and peripherin (PRPH). Collectively, our findings help set the stage for gene-directed therapy for a devasting form of fALS, by establishing the likely disease mechanism and identifying clinical and fluid biomarkers for target engagement and treatment response.

top_journal_neuroscience.title_cn: CHCHD10 R15L 家族肌萎缩侧索硬化症的临床和生化特征。
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 家族性肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS) 是基因定向治疗的潜在候选者，但许多最近发现的基因仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们提供了由 CHCHD10 基因杂合 p.R15L 错义突变引起的家族性 ALS (fALS) 的全面临床、神经病理学和生化描述。我们采用横断面研究设计，评估了来自至少 68 名受影响成员的七代大型谱系中的 5 名受影响个体和 9 名未受影响个体。该谱系表明疾病外显率较高（68%-81%）但不完全。通过克隆来自远亲的疾病等位基因，我们在该家族中建立了疾病单倍型。值得注意的是，该单倍型与之前报道的患有 ALS 的 p.R15L 突变携带者不同，表明该变体处于突变热点。值得注意的是，其临床表现高度刻板化。所有受影响的个体都出现罕见的 ALS 变异连枷臂综合征（FAS；也称为臂肌萎缩性瘫痪或 Vulpian-Bernhardt 综合征），表明颈脊髓受累程度更大。一名家庭成员的神经病理学结果一致表明，颈脊髓与腰脊髓中的 CHCHD10 蛋白聚集和神经元丢失（尽管不存在 TDP-43 病理学）显着增加。这种 FAS 表型可以通过简单的定时手指敲击任务来捕获，表明该任务作为临床生物标志物的潜在用途。此外，通过对来自 12 个突变携带者的成纤维细胞系、同基因诱导多能干细胞和敲入小鼠模型的分析，我们确定带有 R15L 变体的 CHCHD10 在培养细胞和体内稳定表达并保留了实质性功能，这与之前的报道相反。相反，我们发现功能丧失 (LoF) 变异在人群中更为常见，但与英国生物库中高度渗透的 ALS 形式无关（对照中 31 例；病例中 0 例）。总之，这反对 LoF 并支持将毒性功能获得作为疾病发病机制，类似于引起肌病的变异……

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Obesity pharmacotherapies and cognition.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Stina Börchers; Giulia Mazzini; Henrik Zetterberg; Christoffer Clemmensen
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Pharmacotherapies for obesity and type 2 diabetes are increasingly being evaluated for their effects on cognition and brain health. Evidence from preclinical models, observational cohorts, and clinical trials has intensified interest, but findings remain mixed. A central challenge is to determine whether potential cognitive effects arise from direct actions on neural circuits, indirect consequences of improved cardiometabolic health, or both. This Review examines the evidence across cardiometabolic disease, aging, and Alzheimer's disease, focusing on glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1)-based therapies and combination approaches that engage glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide, glucagon, and amylin pathways. We assess how receptor pharmacology, brain exposure, metabolic context, and disease stage shape cognitive outcomes and discuss how mechanistic clarity could guide therapies aimed at preserving or improving cognition.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Targeting hormone conversion through dietary fiber improves polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Xinyu Qi; Hong Chen; Qixing Nie; Hongyu Niu; Yong Ding; Xi Luo; Manfei Si; Shuqi Wu
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Excessive androgens serve as a primary driver for many phenotypic features of polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS). Although dietary fiber has been shown to alleviate PMOS, its effects on androgen concentrations and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In a clinical trial, we demonstrated that a dietary fiber combination consisting of inulin, resistant starch, and β-glucan reduces androgen concentrations in patients' plasma. Mechanistically, dietary fiber increased the abundance of Bacteroides xylanisolvens, which converts androstenedione into a nonandrogenic secondary hormone metabolite we named coproandrosterone, which is further metabolized by gut microbiota into dihydro-coproandrosterone. This metabolic pathway was validated in a mouse model. These findings highlight the potential of dietary fiber to alleviate PMOS by modulating androgen homeostasis through gut microbiota, offering insights for prebiotic and probiotic therapies.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 雄激素过多是多内分泌代谢性卵巢综合征（PMOS）许多表型特征的主要驱动因素。尽管膳食纤维已被证明可以缓解 PMOS，但其对雄激素浓度的影响及其潜在机制仍不清楚。在一项临床试验中，我们证明由菊粉、抗性淀粉和 β-葡聚糖组成的膳食纤维组合可降低患者血浆中的雄激素浓度。从机制上讲，膳食纤维增加了解木聚糖拟杆菌的丰度，该类杆菌将雄烯二酮转化为非雄激素次级激素代谢物，我们将其命名为粪雄酮，它进一步被肠道微生物代谢为二氢粪雄酮。该代谢途径在小鼠模型中得到了验证。这些发现凸显了膳食纤维通过肠道微生物群调节雄激素稳态来缓解 PMOS 的潜力，为益生元和益生菌疗法提供了见解。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: CALB1 expression in meningioma: associations with progression-free survival and chromosome arm 6q loss.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Lukas S Friedrich; Friederike Liesche-Starnecker; Philipp Sievers; Claire Ertelt-Delbridge; Katharina J Weber; Daniel Schrimpf; Nicole Pfarr; Patrick N Harter
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Molecular profiling has refined risk stratification in meningioma, but the biological relevance of associated transcriptional changes remains incompletely understood. Calbindin D28K (Calb), encoded by CALB1, is a calcium-binding protein with reported anti-apoptotic and cytoprotective functions. Previous unsupervised transcriptomic analysis identified CALB1 upregulation in meningiomas with aggressive cellular features, but its biological and clinical relevance remains unresolved. We analysed Calb immunoreactivity in 231 meningioma tissue microarray (TMA) cores from 147 patients and evaluated CALB1 transcript expression, DNA methylation and copy-number alterations in an independent cohort of 110 primary meningiomas. Calb immunoreactivity was detected in approximately 30% of primary tumours, and elevated CALB1 transcript levels were observed at a similar frequency in the molecular cohort. High Calb protein expression was associated with shorter progression-free survival (PFS) after adjustment for the included clinical variables in the primary cohort. This association was also observed in restricted analyses of histological WHO grade 2 meningiomas. Lower methylation of selected exonic and intronic CALB1 CpG sites correlated with a higher transcript expression, consistent with an epigenetic contribution to deregulation. Multivariable analyses identified associations of CALB1 transcript expression with chromosome arm 6q loss, histological WHO grade, CALB1 hypo-methylation and specific methylation subclasses in the secondary cohort. Differential expression analysis of tumours harbouring 6q loss identified expression differences in CALB1 and transcription factors, including NKX2-5 and SOX11. In contrast, expression of a related calcium-binding protein Calretinin (Calr) and the Progesterone Receptor (PR) was not significantly associated with PFS in the primary cohort. Together, these findings support the potential prognostic relevance of Calb protein expression, particularly in histological WHO grade 2 meningiomas, and associate CALB1 transcript expression with selected molecular features in complementary cohorts. Calb immunohistochemistry may therefore provide a practical tool for refining risk stratification in this clinically heterogeneous tumour type prior to integrative molecular testing.

global_hot_topics.title: Ruling out anastomotic leakage after digestive resection: diagnostic accuracy of postoperative day 3 and day 5 C-reactive protein in a single-centre cohort including several anastomotic sites.
global_hot_topics.authors: Asma Sghaier; Mohamed Lahbib; Fatma Ezzahra Nejib; Azza Sridi; Moez Sahnoun; Haroun Guermazi; Rim Bahloul; Aida Abdi
global_hot_topics.abstract: Aims: To evaluate postoperative C-reactive protein (CRP) for ruling out anastomotic leakage (AL) after digestive resection in a cohort including several anastomotic sites.Patients & methods: Prospective single-centre diagnostic accuracy study (STARD 2015) of 82 consecutive patients with an unprotected digestive anastomosis (January 2024-August 2025). CRP was measured on postoperative days (POD) 1, 3 and 5. No analysis was formally prespecified. The primary analysis excluded leaks diagnosed on or before POD 5; a strict analysis also excluded four leaks with an undated diagnosis.Results: AL occurred in 12 patients (14.6%). CRP discriminated on POD 3 (area under the curve [AUC] 0.83; 95% CI: 0.71-0.95) and POD 5 (AUC 0.88; 0.78-0.98) but not on POD 1 in the 71 patients with an available value (AUC 0.59). In the primary pre-diagnosis analysis (79 patients, 9 leaks), an exploratory, data-derived POD 5 cutoff of 127 mg/L had a sensitivity of 77.8% (40.0-97.2) and a negative predictive value of 96.4% (87.7-99.6); in the strict analysis (75 patients, 5 leaks), sensitivity was 80.0% and NPV 98.2%. In the full cohort, sensitivity was 83.3% (apparent) and 76.5% (optimism-corrected). Both false negatives followed gastric resection.Conclusion: A low POD 5 CRP makes AL unlikely, particularly after non-gastric resection, but these data-derived thresholds are exploratory, do not support any change in discharge practice and require external validation. After an operation in which part of the digestive tract is removed and the two ends are joined, the join can leak. A leak is dangerous, but in its first days it is hard to tell apart from normal recovery. We studied a simple blood test, C-reactive protein (CRP), which rises with inflammation, by following 82 patients operated on in one Tunisian hospital between January 2024 and August 2025; 12 developed a leak. On the day after surgery, CRP was high in everyone. By the fifth day, it had fallen in most patients who healed well but stayed high in most of those who leaked. A low value on day 5 made a leak unlikely, especially after bowel surgery, but was less reliable after stomach surgery. Because the study was small and the cutoff values were calculated from the same patients, they must be confirmed in larger studies; on their own, these results do not support any change in when patients go home or whether a scan is performed. The test should always be combined with the doctor’s examination.

global_hot_topics.title: Brain and Cardiometabolic Effects of Major Weight Loss in People With Obesity: Preliminary Cohort Findings.
global_hot_topics.authors: Naomi L Gaggi; Brian Hurwitz; Jennifer Bernal; Courtney O'Brien; Christine Ren-Fielding; Holly Lofton; Jenny Chen; Aviezer Saperstein
global_hot_topics.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Given the overlap between obesity-related metabolic and vascular abnormalities and Alzheimer's disease (AD) risk factors, it is critical to determine whether weight loss improves brain and cardiovascular health. This study examined whether ≥ 40% excess-weight loss is associated with improvements in cardiometabolic risk, brain structure, and cognition. METHODS: The study was a longitudinal study of individuals with obesity undergoing metabolic and bariatric surgery or medical/behavioral weight-loss treatment. Participants were classified at follow-up as weight-loss (WL; ≥ 40% excess-weight loss) or non-weight-loss (nWL; < 40%). All completed medical evaluations, structural MRI, and cognitive testing at baseline and 1 year. RESULTS: At 1 year, the WL group exhibited improvements in BMI, HbA1C, inflammatory, metabolic, and lipid profiles. MRI-based volumetrics revealed increases in subcortical gray-matter volume and preservation of AD-vulnerable regions. Cognitive performance remained unchanged. CONCLUSIONS: Achieving ≥ 40% excess-weight loss was associated with improvements in metabolic health and brain structure, including favorable subcortical volume increases. These findings underscore the potential of sustained weight reduction to mitigate risks linked to metabolic syndromes and neurodegeneration. Longer-term follow-up is warranted to determine whether continued metabolic improvements lead to detectable cognitive gains and additional brain-health benefits beyond 1 year.

global_hot_topics.title: Extended DNA damage-induced G2/M arrests lead to aberrant mitoses through accumulation of securin.
global_hot_topics.authors: Anton Dubenko; Marah Jnied; Oleksii Kotenko; Svetlana Makovets
global_hot_topics.abstract: The stochastic nature of DNA damage dictates various scenarios of stress survival among different cells. We used time-lapse microscopy to perform single-cell level analyses of yeast populations with double-stranded DNA breaks and nonfunctional telomeres. Activation of the DNA damage signalling resulted in a broad distribution in the duration of G2/M arrests. Strikingly, the longer arrests correlated with aberrant mitoses caused by miscoordination of nuclear division and cytokinesis, leading to cell death. Chk1-dependent phosphorylation of Pds1 (securin), an inhibitor of sister chromatid separation in mitosis, was responsible for this phenomenon. Securin progressively accumulated during G2/M arrests, leading to grossly delayed or missed nuclear divisions. This phenotype could be suppressed by slowing down the progression of mitotic exit via LTE1 deletion or by lowering securin levels. global_hot_topics.title: Disease-specific gut microbiota-metabolite-immune networks in hematologic disorders: mechanisms, causal support, and translational strategies.
global_hot_topics.authors: Li Yi; Yuru Yuan; Xiaolong Ma; Chenxi Li; Yushuo Hao; Qianran Ma; Xuexue Liu; Xiao Du
global_hot_topics.abstract: The gut microbiota is increasingly recognized as a systemic regulator of host immunity, host metabolism, epithelial barrier integrity, and distal tissue homeostasis. Hematologic disorders provide an important setting in which these host-microbe interactions converge on immune remodeling, marrow-niche function, hematopoietic recovery, treatment response, and transplant-related complications. This narrative review synthesizes mechanistic, clinical, and translational evidence linking gut microbial dysbiosis to benign and malignant hematologic diseases, clonal and premalignant states, and hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT)-related outcomes. Rather than treating microbiome associations as a single evidence category, we distinguish five complementary evidence strata: Mendelian randomization, experimental models, prospective human cohorts, randomized human interventions, and cross-sectional studies. These study designs address different causal questions and are interpreted as complementary rather than as a single linear hierarchy. We also separate microbial composition from microbial function: taxon-level enrichment or depletion is treated primarily as context-dependent and hypothesis-generating, whereas conserved functional pathways-including short-chain fatty acids, bile-acid transformation, tryptophan metabolism, microbial translocation and barrier dysfunction, and innate immune activation-provide the principal cross-disease mechanistic framework. We integrate disease-specific microbial features, functional mediators, immune and marrow consequences, and clinical outcomes into an author-constructed evidence map, while explicitly addressing bidirectionality, reverse causality, and translational readiness. Emerging applications include microbiota-based biomarkers, treatment-response prediction, fecal microbiota transplantation, probiotics and postbiotics, antibiotic stewardship, and microbiota-dependent modulation of drug metabolism.

global_hot_topics.title: Exploratory serum renal biomarker and eGFR responses to high-protein diets during resistance versus concurrent training in resistance-trained men.
global_hot_topics.journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
global_hot_topics.authors: Reza Bagheri; Zohreh Karimi; Hamid Ghobadi; Fatemeh Kazeminasab; Richard B Kreider; Gordon A Ferns; Majid Ghayour-Mobarhan; Hamidreza Malekinezhad
global_hot_topics.abstract: BACKGROUND: High protein intake is common among resistance-trained athletes, but its association with renal biomarkers across different exercise modalities remains uncertain. This study investigated whether consuming a high-protein diet (3.2 g·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹) during 16 weeks of resistance training (RT) or concurrent training (CT) affects renal biomarkers and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) in resistance-trained men. METHODS: Forty-eight resistance-trained men (26 ± 6 years; BMI 25.6 ± 2.9 kg·m⁻²) were randomized to 16 weeks of RT or CT (4 sessions·wk⁻¹) while consuming either 1.6 or 3.2 g·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹ of protein in a 2 × 2 factorial design. Forty-four participants with complete pre- and post-intervention data were analyzed. Fasting blood samples were assessed for blood urea nitrogen (BUN), BUN/creatinine ratio, cystatin C, and eGFR calculated using the CKD-EPI creatinine (2021), cystatin C (2012), and creatinine-cystatin C (2021) equations. Within-group changes were evaluated using paired t-tests, and factorial effects were assessed using linear mixed-effects models (Time × Training × Protein). RESULTS: No statistically significant Time × Protein or Time × Training × Protein interactions were detected for any renal biomarker or eGFR estimate (all p ≥ 0.182). No significant within-group changes occurred in the 1.6 g·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹ groups (all p > 0.05). In both 3.2 g·kg⁻¹·d⁻¹ groups, BUN and cystatin C increased (all p ≤ 0.017), while eGFR estimates decreased (all p ≤ 0.009). The BUN/creatinine ratio remained unchanged (p ≥ 0.614). However, these within-group findings were descriptive because the corresponding interaction effects were not statistically significant. CONCLUSIONS: In resistance-trained men, 16 weeks of high protein intake did not produce statistically detectable differences in renal biomarker or eGFR changes compared with moderate protein intake, irrespective of training modality. Although modest increases in BUN and cystatin C and small decreases in eGFR estimates were observed within the high-protein groups, these findings were not supported by significant factorial interactions. The limited sample size precludes excluding clinically meaningful differences, warranting further investigation in larger studies.

global_hot_topics.title: Neurotropic herpesviruses as accelerators of brain aging: The role of latency and reactivation in neurodegeneration.
global_hot_topics.authors: Pooja Nadholta; Ipsita Volety; Deepak Shukla
global_hot_topics.abstract: Neurotropic herpesviruses establish lifelong latency within the human nervous system. Traditionally viewed as either harmless latent infections or rare causes of acute encephalitis, growing evidence suggests these viruses undergo recurrent, subclinical reactivations throughout life. This review summarizes recent advances and introduces the multiple-hit viral reactivation model, proposing that repeated silent reactivation events act as cumulative biological stressors that accelerate brain aging. We describe a self-reinforcing cycle in which age-related immunosenescence impairs control of viral latency, leading to recurrent subclinical reactivation, chronic neuroinflammation, cellular senescence, and progressive disruption of central nervous system homeostasis. Rather than directly causing neurodegenerative disease, recurrent host-virus interactions gradually diminish brain resilience and promote the accumulation of pathogenic protein aggregates, including amyloid-β, tau, α-synuclein, and TDP-43. Clinical neurodegeneration emerges when the cumulative burden of lifelong viral reactivation exceeds the aging brain's capacity to maintain homeostasis. Recognizing herpesviruses as modifiable drivers of brain aging identifies subclinical viral reactivation as a key therapeutic target for preventing cognitive decline.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 嗜神经性疱疹病毒在人类神经系统内建立终生潜伏期。传统上被视为无害的潜伏感染或急性脑炎的罕见原因，越来越多的证据表明这些病毒在一生中会经历反复的、亚临床的再激活。这篇综述总结了最新进展，并介绍了多重打击病毒再激活模型，提出重复的沉默再激活事件可作为累积的生物应激源，加速大脑衰老。我们描述了一个自我强化的循环，其中与年龄相关的免疫衰老损害了病毒潜伏期的控制，导致反复的亚临床再激活、慢性神经炎症、细胞衰老和中枢神经系统稳态的逐渐破坏。反复发生的宿主与病毒相互作用不会直接引起神经退行性疾病，而是会逐渐削弱大脑的恢复能力，并促进致病蛋白聚集体的积累，包括淀粉样蛋白-β、tau、α-突触核蛋白和 TDP-43。当终生病毒再激活的累积负担超过衰老大脑维持体内平衡的能力时，就会出现临床神经退行性变。认识到疱疹病毒是大脑衰老的可改变驱动因素，将亚临床病毒再激活确定为预防认知能力下降的关键治疗目标。

global_hot_topics.title: Adaptive kinase signaling enables escape from small molecule inhibition in glioblastoma.
global_hot_topics.authors: Mike van Heumen; Linde Hoosemans; Jolanda Piepers; Sander S M Rensen; Kim R Kampen; Ann Hoeben; Marc A Vooijs
global_hot_topics.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Patients with glioblastoma (GB) have a median survival of 15 months, despite intensive treatment with surgical resection, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy. A major challenge in overcoming treatment resistance is intratumoral heterogeneity, characterized by molecular, phenotypic, and clinical diversity. Small-molecule inhibitors (SMIs) target specific oncogenic signaling pathways and have become successful therapies in several molecularly defined cancers. In GB, however, SMIs have thus far failed to substantially improve patient outcomes. Here, we used a primary patient-derived glioblastoma organoid (PGO) platform to investigate adaptive bypass signaling mechanisms that drive resistance to targeted therapy. METHODS: Six primary PGOs were treated with nine FDA-approved SMIs selected for their blood-brain barrier permeability and ability to target key GB driver genes. Drug sensitivity was assessed by cell viability measurements and IC₅₀ determination. To identify compensatory signaling mechanisms, kinase activity profiling was performed following monotherapy treatment. RESULTS: Although inhibition of downstream effector proteins reduced cell viability more effectively (IC₅₀: 70 nM-1 μM) than inhibition of upstream receptor tyrosine kinases (IC₅₀: 1-15 μM), residual proliferation persisted in all PGOs. Kinase profiling revealed compensatory pathway activation following monotherapy, enabling the identification of effective SMI combinations. The most prominent combination targeted glycogen synthase kinase-3 (GSK-3) and mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase (MEK) using CHIR99021 and trametinib, respectively. CONCLUSION: These findings demonstrate that adaptive bypass signaling limits single-agent SMI efficacy in GB. PGO-based kinase profiling enables the identification of resistance mechanisms and rational combination therapies, supporting its application in personalized treatment development.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 目的：尽管经过手术切除、放疗和化疗等强化治疗，胶质母细胞瘤 (GB) 患者的中位生存期仍为 15 个月。克服治疗耐药性的一个主要挑战是肿瘤内异质性，其特征是分子、表型和临床多样性。小分子抑制剂 (SMI) 针对特定的致癌信号通路，已成为多种分子定义癌症的成功疗法。然而，在英国，SMI 迄今为止未能显着改善患者的治疗结果。在这里，我们使用原发性患者来源的胶质母细胞瘤类器官（PGO）平台来研究导致对靶向治疗产生耐药性的适应性旁路信号机制。方法：使用 FDA 批准的 9 种 SMI 治疗 6 个原发性 PGO，这些 SMI 是根据其血脑屏障通透性和靶向关键 GB 驱动基因的能力而选择的。通过细胞活力测量和 IC50 测定来评估药物敏感性。为了确定补偿信号传导机制，在单一疗法治疗后进行了激酶活性分析。结果：尽管抑制下游效应蛋白比抑制上游受体酪氨酸激酶（IC50：1-15 μM）更有效地降低细胞活力（IC50：70 nM-1 μM），但所有 PGO 中仍然存在残余增殖。激酶分析揭示了单一疗法后补偿途径的激活，从而能够识别有效的 SMI 组合。最突出的组合分别使用 CHIR99021 和曲美替尼靶向糖原合成酶激酶 3 (GSK-3) 和丝裂原激活蛋白激酶激酶 (MEK)。结论：这些发现表明，自适应旁路信号传导限制了单药 SMI 在英国的疗效。基于 PGO 的激酶分析能够识别耐药机制和合理的联合疗法，支持其在个性化治疗开发中的应用。

medical_news.title: The brain’s hidden fear mechanism may explain anxiety and PTSD
medical_news.abstract: A surprising new discovery suggests that fear may cause the brain to blur the line between danger and safety rather than distinguish them more clearly. By observing brain activity in mice using augmented reality, scientists found that memories of threatening and harmless environments began to overlap, potentially allowing faster responses to danger. This "better safe than sorry" survival mechanism could help explain why people with anxiety or PTSD sometimes experience intense fear in completely safe situations.
